# Abiding Peace

<center>

<audio controls>
  <source src="https://ngsm.org/mp3/Abiding%20Peace.mp3" type="audio/mpeg">
  Your browser does not support the audio element.
</audio>

</center>

May the Holy Ones<br>
Whose disciple I am <br>
show me the light I seek; <br>
give me the strong aid <br>
of Their compassion <br>
and Their wisdom. <br>

There is a peace <br>
which passeth understanding; <br>
it abides in the hearts <br>
of those who live in the Eternal. <br>

There is a power <br>
which maketh all things new; <br>
it lives and moves <br>
in those who know the Self as one. <br>

May that peace brood over us, <br>
that power uplift us <br>
till we stand <br>
where the One Initiator is invoked, <br>
till we see <br>
His star shine forth!<br>

Musicalized by José Becerra. Lyrics source: an invocation for disciples by Alice A. Bailey (Discipleship in the New Age, Vol. I, p. 359, published by Lucis Trust)

<center>
**Saint Francis Prayer**

**Instrumental by José Becerra**
</center>


<center>
<audio controls>
  <source src="https://ngsm.org/mp3/Lord,%20make%20me%20an%20instrument%20of%20your%20peace.mp3" type="audio/mpeg">
  Your browser does not support the audio element.
</audio>
</center>

Lord, make me an instrument of your peace: <br>
where there is hatred, let me sow love; <br>
where there is injury, pardon; <br>
where there is doubt, faith; <br>
where there is despair, hope; <br>
where there is darkness, light; <br>
where there is sadness, joy. <br>
O divine Master, grant that I may not so much seek <br>
to be consoled as to console, <br>
to be understood as to understand, <br>
to be loved as to love. <br>
For it is in giving that we receive, <br>
it is in pardoning that we are pardoned, <br>
and it is in dying that we are born to eternal life.<br>

<br>

>*What is a monstrance? It is a sunburst-patterned vessel used to display the consecrated Eucharistic host, for adoration.* 

>An esoteric interpretation of the Monstrance: a "living" symbol of the Eucharist, a sacred tool or means to connect with and honor "Christos - Sophia (Holy Spirit)",,,The Christ and Holy Spirit as a synthesis of the Divine Masculine and Divine Feminine in Unity... the Trend to Synthesis, an expression of "the Good, the Beautiful and the True." -[Esoteric Advent](https://www.esotericadvent.org/)
